>>L<< 4TH SPEED GEAR INSTALLATION
1. Set the output shaft on the press support stand.
2. Using special tools MD998812, MD998813, MD998819 
<F5M42>, MD998821 <F5M51> and MD998364 <F5M51>, 
press install the 4th speed gear onto the output shaft.
>>M<< 5TH SPEED GEAR SLEEVE INSTALLATION
Using special tools MD998812, MD998813, MD998819 
<F5M42>, MD998821 <F5M51> and MD998364 <F5M51>, 
press install the 5th speed gear sleeve onto the output shaft.
